title: 第25章 爽赚第26章 免费灵药
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
苏铭踏入外门弟子的交易区域，此地名为四海坊市。
他一心准备摆摊卖货，刚寻到一处空位站定。
“嘿，小子！”一道带着嚣张意味的声音骤然响起。
苏铭抬眸，只见一个外门弟子模样的家伙，大摇大摆地走来，身后还跟着几个面露凶相的跟班。此人正是杜鸿德。
“这地儿，我罩着的，想摆摊，保护费拿来！”杜鸿德鼻孔朝天，一脸傲然，仿佛这四海坊市就是他家开的。
苏铭心中冷笑，他之前可是仔细打听过，此地乃是宗门特意设立的自由交易区，压根就没有什么保护费一说。
“滚一边去，别在这瞎咧咧。”苏铭毫不客气地回怼，语气冷得能冻死人。
“哟呵？”杜鸿德像是听到了天大的笑话，“你小子知道我是谁不？我可是这四海坊市的管理者，在这摆摊，就得听我的！”他一边说着，一边伸手就要去抓苏铭的货物。
苏铭眼神瞬间一寒，“我管你是谁，这地儿不收保护费，别拿你那套唬我。”
“不识好歹！”杜鸿德恼羞成怒，大手一挥，冲身后小弟喊道，“给我砸了他的摊子！”
那些小弟们如恶狼一般，张牙舞爪地朝着苏铭的摊子扑去。
苏铭心中怒火“噌”地一下就冒了起来，谁敢断他财路，那就是与他不死不休！
“哼！”他冷哼一声，身形一闪，如鬼魅一般欺身而上。
“砰砰砰！”几拳挥出，那速度快得只留下一道道残影。
“啊！”杜鸿德的小弟们根本来不及反应，就被苏铭一拳一个，像破麻袋一样飞了出去，重重摔在地上，疼得嗷嗷直叫。
杜鸿德见状，脸上一阵白一阵红，他怎么也没想到，这个看起来平平无奇的苏铭，居然如此能打。
“你……你敢动手？”杜鸿德色厉内荏地吼道，声音都因为意外和愤怒而微微颤抖。
苏铭拍了拍手，冷冷地看向杜鸿德，那眼神仿佛在看一个死人，“再来招惹我，下一个就是你！”
杜鸿德心中一凛，这苏铭，竟如此难缠！
当下，他恶狠狠地甩下狠话：“哼！你给我记着，我可是邵子墨师兄的人，你敢动我，有你好受的！”

言罢，便想脚底抹油，赶紧溜之大吉。
可苏铭怎会轻易放过他？心中冷哼一声，这杜鸿德，屡次挑衅，今日若不给他个深刻教训，日后必定还会惹出更多麻烦。
念头一闪，苏铭身形如电，瞬间欺身而上，大喝一声：“威胁我了还想走？没那么容易！”
紧接着，砂锅大的拳头裹挟着滚滚灵力，仿若一颗出膛炮弹，带着一往无前的气势，直直朝着杜鸿德后背砸去。
“砰！”这一拳，势大力沉，直接将杜鸿德砸得向前扑出数丈之远。
杜鸿德整个人如遭雷击，在空中划过一道弧线后，重重地摔落在地，溅起一片尘土。
“啊！”杜鸿德发出杀猪般的惨叫，那声音凄厉无比，仿若夜枭啼鸣，在这天地间回荡。
他挣扎着想要爬起来，却发现浑身剧痛，骨头好似散了架一般，每挪动一下，都好似有千万根钢针在扎。
此刻的杜鸿德，心中满是懊悔与恐惧。他怎么也没想到，自己不过是想在这新人面前耍耍威风，竟招惹到了这么一个狠角色。
看着苏铭一步步朝自己走来，杜鸿德的眼神中充满了绝望，他的嘴唇颤抖着，却再也说不出一句狠话。
周遭众人，皆似被施了定身咒一般，呆立当场。
他们的面庞之上，尽皆写满了震惊，双目圆睁，嘴巴大张，仿佛能塞下一个鸡蛋。
“这杜鸿德，在这坊市作威作福，横行无忌许久了。”
“平日里，净干那以强凌弱、欺负弱小的腌臜勾当，可把咱这些平头百姓害惨咯！”
content_en:
Su Ming stepped into the trading area of ​​the outer disciples, which was called Sihaifang City.
He was preparing to set up a stall and sell goods, and he just found an empty place to stand.
"Hey, kid!" An arrogant voice suddenly sounded.
Su Ming raised his eyes and saw a guy who looked like an outer disciple, walking swaggeringly, followed by several followers with fierce looks on their faces. This person is Du Hongde.
"I'm covering this place. I want to set up a stall. Get the protection money!" Du Hongde's nostrils were turned upward, with a look of pride on his face, as if Sihaifang City was owned by his family.
Su Ming sneered in his heart. He had carefully inquired before and found that this place was a free trade zone specially established by the sect. There was no protection fee at all.
"Get out of here, don't act blindly here." Su Ming retorted unceremoniously, with a tone so cold that it could freeze someone to death.
"Haha?" Du Hongde seemed to have heard a big joke, "Do you know who I am? I am the manager of Sihaifang City. If you set up a stall here, you have to listen to me!" As he said this, he stretched out his hand to grab Su Ming's goods.
Su Ming's eyes turned cold for a moment, "I don't care who you are, we don't charge protection fees here, don't bluff me with your tricks."
"You don't know what is good!" Du Hongde became angry and waved his hand, shouting to the younger brother behind him, "Smash his stall!"
The boys were like wolves, baring their teeth and claws and rushing toward Su Ming's stall.
Anger suddenly arose in Su Ming's heart. Anyone who dared to cut off his financial path would fight him to the death!
"Hmph!" He snorted coldly, and with a flash of his body, he stalked up to him like a ghost.
"Bang bang bang!" Several punches were thrown out, so fast that only afterimages were left.
"Ah!" Du Hongde's younger brothers had no time to react. They were punched by Su Ming one by one. They flew out like broken sacks and fell heavily to the ground, screaming in pain.
When Du Hongde saw this, his face turned white and red. He never expected that Su Ming, who looked ordinary, could be so good at fighting.
"You...you dare to take action?" Du Hongde roared fiercely, his voice trembling slightly from surprise and anger.
Su Ming clapped his hands and looked at Du Hongde coldly, as if looking at a dead person, "If you mess with me again, you will be next!"
Du Hongde was shocked, this Su Ming was so difficult to deal with!
At that moment, he said harshly: "Hmph! Remember, I am a member of Senior Brother Shao Zimo. If you dare to touch me, you will suffer a lot!"
After saying that, I wanted to rub oil on the soles of my feet and run away quickly.
But how could Su Ming let him go so easily? He snorted coldly in his heart, this Du Hongde has repeatedly provoked him, if he is not taught a profound lesson today, he will definitely cause more trouble in the future.
As soon as the thought flashed, Su Ming's figure was like lightning, and he immediately bullied him and shouted: "You threaten me and still want to leave? It's not that easy!"
Immediately afterwards, a fist as big as a casserole was packed with rolling spiritual energy, like a cannonball being discharged, and it hit Du Hongde's back with an indomitable momentum.
"Bang!" This punch was so powerful that it knocked Du Hongde forward several feet.
Du Hongde felt as if he was struck by lightning. After drawing an arc in the air, he fell heavily to the ground, splashing a cloud of dust.
"Ah!" Du Hongde screamed like a slaughtering pig. The sound was extremely shrill, like the cry of a night owl, echoing throughout the world.
He struggled to get up, but found that his whole body was in severe pain, and his bones seemed to be falling apart. Every time he moved, it felt like thousands of steel needles were pricking him.
At this moment, Du Hongde's heart was full of regret and fear. He never thought that he would provoke such a ruthless person just because he wanted to show off his power in front of this newcomer.
Seeing Su Ming walking towards him step by step, Du Hongde's eyes were full of despair, his lips were trembling, but he could no longer say a harsh word.
Everyone around seemed to have been cast a restraining spell.Standing frozen on the spot.
Their faces were all filled with shock, their eyes were wide open, and their mouths were wide open, as if they could fit an egg in.
"This Du Hongde has been domineering in this city for a long time."
"On weekdays, if you just do that dirty business of bullying the weak and bullying the weak, it will cause great harm to ordinary people like us!"
